# Stop, rebuild and continue the same trajectory

[Publish a field checkpoint, restore into new fields and a new clock, and compare against an uninterrupted run.]{.lesson-deck}
:::

A field file becomes a restart only when the rest of the accepted state
can be interpreted consistently. This example evolves $u_t=-u$ with the
visible Euler update $u^{m+1}=(1-h)u^m$, starting from $1+.2\cos x$.
It compares eight uninterrupted steps with three steps, a checkpoint,
and five steps after rebuilding the state from disk.

## Save an accepted state, then create a new one

```{.cpp include="model.cpp" snippet="checkpoint" dedent=4}
```

`CheckpointService` publishes all named double fields and metadata. The new
registry starts with zero values, so a successful comparison must actually
restore the saved samples. A new `Time` has the same start, end, fixed step
and method identity. The result counter, set to seven before saving, is
also recovered; it need not equal the step increment.

## Compare the right trajectory

The discrete oracle is

$$u^m(x)=(1-h)^m(1+.2\cos x).$$ {#eq-discrete-decay}

The continuous solution $e^{-mh}(1+.2\cos x)$ differs by Euler truncation
error. A successful restart should preserve the discrete calculation's
answer; it cannot remove the integrator's error. Here both paths use the
same pointwise updates, so we require exactly equal stored final values.

## Read what was published

```sh
openpfc run model.cpp input.json --launcher=none
```

This source-driven lesson ignores its empty input; edit `dt`, `split` and
`steps` in the C++ source. The checkpoint is under
`results/checkpoints/step_3/`; the final comparison is
`results/restart_rank_<rank>.csv`. Use two ranks to exercise collective
publication and load. The checks inspect checkpoint metadata, validate
every final global sample, and verify the restored result counter.

This chapter uses a fixed step deliberately. The service reconstructs
accepted time from the stored increment and the configured fixed-step
clock, then checks that it matches the metadata. It is not a demonstration
of restarting an arbitrary adaptive history. Adaptive controller memory,
method caches and external constitutive history need their own explicit
restart contracts. The public
[checkpoint service](https://github.com/VTT-ProperTune/OpenPFC/blob/master/include/openpfc/kernel/simulation/checkpoint_service.hpp)
checks domain and method identity before loading the field bundle.

The complete [C++ model](model.cpp) and [starting input](input.json)
are available with this lesson.
